domainPull: The pull was strongest at Step 4 and Step 5. The rule \"A tank may hold more than its volume after receiving returned liquor ... it is never dealt with and stays in the tank\" contradicts how a physical tank behaves, and so does the line \"If tank 1 is OVERLOADED, its amount goes to outfall\", since a return line at the inlet would not discharge to outfall. A real storm bypass diverts inflow rather than halving every tank's contents. The cycle-5 end state (T2 at 10 against a volume of 8, T4 at 7 against 6, and a total of exactly 38 with no bypass) is where water and sewage treatment intuition would most tempt a correction, but neither reporting operator made one.
